title: Taller essentials: researched and modelled Backing and table types, type cards and every-type Blender export
note: las mesas quese arreglaron no sepuedn arrastrar y colocar, si el probelma es otro, investigalo y solucionalo

tests.where: Local Probar version and owner Blender
tests.how: SP-3 ships in M2, after M1. First, when T3.2 finishes: read `docs/req021/propuesta-backing-mesas.md` and name which Backings and table types are modelled (the coordinator records your answer; you may approve none). Then, with SP-1's test database/account setup, sign in as master-designer@ (Master Designer) and open /3d → Añadir → Fondos y muebles. 1) In «Mesas» touch the Rectangular card (also search «rectangular»), then each new table-type card; edit size and chairs in the existing editor, undo, and open the shopping list. 2) Open the Backing group: add each of the seven existing props and each approved new Backing; search «Backing» and original names such as «Aro metálico». 3) Load a scene with every kind of element, export it as GLB, import it in Blender (metres) and compare. Run `npm run taller:test-integracion-esenciales` for the automated flow (portable Blender under ~/.local/opt/blender, explicitly provisioned with `npm run taller:preparar-blender`, T3.12, without pacman). In T3.9/T3.10's UI tests check the existing card/group patterns at 390 px phone, 768 px tablet and 1280 px desktop widths; verify no new screen or navigation is introduced.
tests.expect: 1) One card per table type; each adds the default-size table (rectangular 240 × 90 × 75 cm) and opens today's editor; capacity warnings explain unplaced chairs; the list shows quantities and dimensions without rental prices. 2) Backing contains the seven old props and approved new ones once each, removed from «Fondos y tapetes» and «Decorado de pie»; original names still find them. 3) Every element type keeps position/size within 1 mm and base colours within 1/255 in Blender, or evidence names the failing type as a defect; material/lighting limits are documented. The export menu stays as today. Existing Taller card/group patterns work at phone, tablet and desktop widths with no new screen/navigation. Missing Blender is blocked/manual evidence, never a pass.
